notes: These profiles define analysis sampling ranges, not dynamics or stability validation.
Use analysis_default for the first 10-DoF base_link workspace report.
Run reachability analysis before manipulability analysis.
Use finer spatial resolution only after voxel density is verified at 0.05 m.
Coordinate convention: base_link +X = robot left, +Y = robot rear, +Z = up, forward = -Y.
Reachability generation should sample within these joint ranges and should not apply additional semantic posture filters.

analysis_default.description: Default waist-leg sampling range for reachability-first 10-DoF kinematic analysis.

wider_kinematic.description: Wider waist-leg sampling range for sensitivity checks.

full_urdf.description: Raw URDF limits for upper-bound diagnostics only; not recommended as the main report profile.
